channel.title: Polished Insurance guides
channel.description: Insurance guides for UK cleaning businesses.

item.title: Employers' Liability Insurance for Cleaning Companies Explained
item.description: If your cleaning business has staff, casual helpers or labour-only subcontractors, employers' liability cover is almost certainly a legal requirement. Here is who counts, what the law says, and what insurers will ask you.

item.title: Treatment Risks: The Gap in Standard Public Liability
item.description: Most standard public liability policies will not pay for the item you are actually cleaning. We explain damage to property worked upon.

item.title: Handling Accidental Damage: A Step-by-Step Guide
item.description: Breaking a client's item is every cleaner's nightmare. Here is the professional way to handle it.

item.title: Keyholding Risks Explained: Protecting Your Client's Security
item.description: Holding keys for clients is a big responsibility. Learn how to manage keys securely and check your insurance covers you if you lose them.

item.title: The True Cost of a Claim: It's More Than Just the Breakage
item.description: Think a broken vase just costs the price of a replacement? We explore the hidden costs of liability claims.

item.title: COSHH Explained Simply: A Cleaner's Guide to Safety
item.description: Chemical safety does not have to be complicated. Our simple guide to COSHH helps you stay safe and compliant.

item.title: Public Liability vs Employers' Liability: What's the Difference?
item.description: We break down the key differences between public and employers' liability, and which your cleaning business actually needs.

item.title: Legal Liability for Cleaners Entering Client Premises
item.description: Your duty of care, keyholding risks and legal responsibilities when working in a client's home or office.

item.title: Do I Really Need Insurance for My Cleaning Business?
item.description: Many new cleaners ask whether insurance is a legal requirement. Here is what the law says, and why going without is a big risk.
